sourceChecks.note: The exact official U.S. page independently validates identity, the $1,000 USD recommended retail price, limited current production, fixed cow-leather configuration, 36 x 12.5 x 41.4 mm geometry, 18 mm lug width, calibre 6R51, -15/+25 seconds per day, 72-hour reserve, 10 bar water resistance, sapphire crystal, and a three-fold clasp.

Seiko's official Japanese store page for the same HCC004J regional product code independently reports a 66.0 g full weight and corroborates the same case, leather configuration, movement, accuracy, reserve, and water-resistance specifications.

Seiko's official calibre manual distinguishes 6R51 as a three-hand time-only movement and specifies time setting without a calendar, independently supporting absent date status for the exact product's documented calibre.

Seiko's exact official Netherlands specification reports luminous hands, luminous indexes, and Lumibrite. Other official regional pages omit lume, and the exact-reference independent inspection below directly contradicts this regional specification, so no categorical lume value is accepted.

The exact-reference independent inspection reports that HCC004 lacks luminous paint and is consequently less visible in the dark. This conflicts with Seiko Netherlands' exact official Lumibrite rows, so the conflict is retained rather than resolved by source hierarchy alone.

The exact HCC004J1 retailer page identifies a standard attachment system and explicitly defines that system as spring-loaded metal bars housed between the lugs. This directly establishes the strap-to-case interface as spring_bar.
